plan.notes: Sources (all official, retrieved 2026-09-30): (1) the official EMU catalog program page 'Program: Criminology and Criminal Justice [BA]' for the approved elective list and the 120-credit minimum; (2) the official EMU catalog 'Program: Criminology and Criminal Justice [BA] - MiTransfer Pathway' page for the Juvenile Justice (CRM JVJS) concentration (CRM 355, CRM 356 + nine hours from the approved list); (3) the archived official EMU Criminology & Criminal Justice articulation guide for the 21-credit CRM core course list, SOCL 304 Methods in Sociological Research, and SOCL 462 Complex Organizations; (4) the official EMU General Education worksheet (FA22) for gen-ed structure. catalog.emich.edu presents an AWS WAF challenge to automated fetching, so catalog content was verified through the search index of the official catalog pages; every code, title and credit below comes from those official sources. Major = 42 hours: 27 core (CRM 301, 338, 354, 362, 370, 431, 447W + SOCL 304 + SOCL 462) + 15 Juvenile Justice concentration (CRM 355 Juvenile Justice Policy, CRM 356 Schools & Crime, CRM 412 Law and Society, CRM 420 Drugs, Crime and Criminal Justice, PLSC 385 Judicial Process and Behavior). The archived guide cites a 33-39 range for other concentration configurations; the JVJS concentration as documented totals 42. CRM 447W Senior Seminar satisfies the [GEWI] Writing Intensive requirement in the major; this major does not require a minor. PREREQUISITES ARE NOT ENCODED: catalog course pages are WAF-blocked and prereqs are never invented - courses are sequenced lower-to-upper; confirm with the catalog and an advisor. 42 major + 40 gen-ed = 82 specified; free-elective choice slots (38 cr) reach the 120-credit minimum.
